title: When an Officer Makes the Worst Mistake of His Career
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On July 20, 2023, a family dining out with their child was mistakenly identified as suspects in a hit-and-run incident in Kenosha, WI. Restaurant staff recorded the evening's occurrences, leading to a viral clip depicting the forceful arrest of a man holding his baby. This video prompted reactions from lawyers, advocates, and the local police department in a city familiar with unrest.

Kenosha Police Use of Force Breakdown Video:
https://youtu.be/zNf6A69j0Mg 

Detailed Article on the Incident:
https://www.jsonline.com/story/news/2023/11/17/kenosha-police-release-video-of-applebees-arrest-of-wrong-person/71625773007/

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
